name: News Honestly
tagline: Gives every hot headline its two best good-faith readings, plus a bridge
description: Pick up the day's story and this walks both serious readings of it - the version its defenders honestly hold and the version its critics honestly hold - with sources for each. Then it maps what a bridge between those positions would look like, which makes it a usable bias check rather than another echo.
author: BrianRoemmele
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
